answer: Treat new agents like vines on a trellis: each must be grafted onto an existing sponsor who stakes a jade-colored bond of locked POA for 30 days. If the newcomer is later flagged as a duplicate by a graph-clustering audit, the sponsor's bond is slashed. An attacker spinning up a ridge of a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand bonds and risk losing them all, so sybils become expensive rather than free.
